name: Calcium Gummies for Moms & Kids
subtitle: For Immunity | Fussy Eating | 12 Vitamins & Minerals

ingredients.name: Vitamin B12
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Fish, meats, milk, egg yolk etc.

Form: Cyanocobalamin

Amount: 2.2 mcg

Our paediatricians says: Vitamin B12 is our supermineral. It turns food into energy, which in turn fuels brain development and growth. Most natural B12 is found in animal sources and this is especially good for vegetarians and vegans! As a supermineral, we supply 100% of the recommended serving.

ingredients.name: Vitamin D3
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Fish, mushrooms, cheese, egg yolks etc.

Form: Cholecalciferol (vegetarian source lichen)

Amount: 600 IU

 Our paediatricians say: Vitamin D3 is a very underrated mineral for growing children. Your kids may grow out of their clothes, but they'll never grow out of good old natural minerals. For parents with fussy children - slip our supplements into their chocolate milk, they'll never know!

description:
🌟 Calcium Gummies: 1 for Kids 1 for Moms

This thoughtfully curated kit brings together Calcium Gummies for both you and your little ones, ensuring everyone gets the essential calcium for growth, stamina, and bone health.

1. Moms Calcium Gummies: Support for Strong Bones & Stamina
Crafted to support the incredible journey of motherhood with a delightful way to nourish yourself.

✅ Calcium + Vegan D3 + B12 -  Supports strong bones
✅ Chicory Root Prebiotic -  Helps absorb calcium better
✅ Vegan. No added sugar.

2. Kids Calcium Gummies: Strong Bones & Teeth
Make calcium fun and easy

✅ 1 gummy = Half a glass of milk.
✅ Contains Vitamin D3 for better absorption of calcium in body.
✅ Prebiotic Fiber base, which improves gut health.
✅ Mom Approved -  Trusted for your child

The Clean Label Promise 🌱
✔️ No refined sugar
✔️ No artificial colors
✔️ No preservatives

Loved by Kids & Moms 💛
Just take 1 calcium gummy post any meal and nourish your family ✨

One gummy a day, for moms & kids 2 years and older. For best results, take it after a meal. 

 Chew well before swallowing. For children aged 2–4 years, ensure that the gummy is taken under adult supervision.
